profile.name: Herald Ago
profile.bioParagraph1: Italian with Albanian roots, born and raised in Padua. After a Bachelor in Communication Science & Technologies, I moved to Miami, then headed to Denmark for an MSc in IT – Web Communication Design. After returning to Italy, I now live between Italy and Barcelona.
profile.bioParagraph2: Passionate about design, AI, sociology, books, and travel. Beyond the screen, I love good food, great wine, and spending time with family and friends.
profile.shortBio: Padua, Miami, MSc in Denmark. Living between Italy & Barcelona. Design, AI, sociology & fine wine.

testimonials.name: Antonio
testimonials.fullQuote: Herald has rare proactivity and deep study. The dedication he brings to preparing every detail and the immediate trust he inspires in people will take him very far.
